m.d: An idea is a concept or a thought.
An idea is something abstract (not concrete).
An idea is a way to see something, a view.
m.e: He changed her ideas on religion.

m.d: Your identity is your name, your personality, and the things that make you different from other people.
m.e: Before I can give you money from your bank account, you have to prove your identity.

m.d: The way an organisation shows itself to the public
If you identify something, you say what it is.
m.e: I showed him the picture and he identified the man as his brother.

m.d: If x identifies y, x makes it easy to know what y is.
If you identify with someone else, you understand and share their feelings.
An ideal is a perfect example of something.
m.e: When he looked at her, he saw the feminine ideal.

m.d: If something is ideal, it is as good as you can imagine.
m.e: You can lose weight safely, and maintain your ideal weight forever.

m.d: If something is ideal, it is perfect or flawless; it does not have anything wrong with it.
An idol is a famous person who is greatly admired, loved by many people.
An image of a god that people pray to.
If two ore more things are identical, they are exactly the same.
m.e: The teachers teach from identical textbooks, but the ways they teach are quite different.

m.d: Identification is the process of naming a thing by seeing it, hearing it, and/or touching it.
m.e: With finding new animals, the process of identification is a long and difficult one.

m.d: If a car is idle, it is on but is not moving.
m.e: Jack left his car idling while went inside the store to get bread.

m.d: If someone is idle, they are not active or working.
m.e: The idle workers are going to be replaced by more ambitious employees.

m.d: Your ideals are the basic ideas that you think are good and true.
m.e: This country is built on the ideals of freedom, and hard work.

m.d: If a person is called idiotic, they are acting like an idiot.
If a situation is described as idiotic, it is very foolish, stupid, or does not make much sense.
Idaho is a state of the United States of America.
m.e: Boise is the capital of Idaho.

m.d: An ideology is the set of beliefs behind a movement, religion, political group, etc.
m.e: Schools reflect clearly the dominant political ideologies of their countries.

m.d: In an idle manner, without specific purpose, intent or effort.
In a lazy and aimless way.
An idealist is a person who is idealistic.
m.e: Helen is an idealist, she thinks people can change the world.
